scope: uni-app DCloud stable dependency upgrade preflight
decision: Keep the coherent DCloud stable package set because type-check, H5, and WeChat builds pass. Do not apply npm audit fix --force: it proposes replacing @dcloudio/uni-cli-shared with 0.2.994 and moving pinned Rollup outside its stated range. Security findings remain a release gate and need a framework-compatible upstream fix or narrowly validated overrides.
limitations: This is a dependency compatibility preflight, not the final cross-platform acceptance run.
No native iOS/Android/macOS build, mini-program upload, or real-device acceptance was performed in this preflight.
The H5 and WeChat outputs are local candidates and are not deployed or submitted.
